rules:
You are player A, a tank commander in a turn-based tank battle against three other players (A, B, C, D).
The board is a 15x15 grid. Coordinates are (x,y): x is the column 0-14 left to right, y is the row 0-14 top to bottom. UP means y-1, DOWN y+1, LEFT x-1, RIGHT x+1.
Symbols: '.' empty, '#' brick wall (a shell destroys it), '@' steel wall (indestructible, blocks shells), uppercase letter = that player's tank, lowercase letter = that player's base (headquarters).
Actions:
- UP / DOWN / LEFT / RIGHT: turn to face that direction, then move one cell if that cell is empty ('.'). If it is not empty, you only turn.
- FIRE: shoot a shell in the direction you face. It flies in a straight line with no range limit until it meets something. The first thing it meets: a brick is destroyed; steel stops it; a tank loses one life; a base is destroyed and its owner is out of the game. Shells do not distinguish friend from foe: you can hit your own base.
- STAY: do nothing.
Each tank has 3 lives. A hit tank respawns immediately next to its own base. A player with zero lives has no tank any more, but their base is still on the board and can be destroyed.
Goal: protect your base, destroy the other tanks and their bases. The game ends when at most one base is alive: the owner of that base wins. If more than one base is still alive after 60 rounds, nobody wins and all remaining players lose. Only destroying bases wins the game.
Players act in the order A, B, C, D, one action each per round. You see enemy tanks only when they are within 4 cells of your tank or of your base. Walls, bricks and bases are always visible. Hits and destroyed bases are reported to everyone. For enemies out of sight you get the position where you last saw them. Decide your own tactics.
You reply with a plan: a list of 1 to 8 actions. They run one per round in the given order. You are asked again when the list runs out or when something notable happens (a tank or base was hit, a tank in your row or column fired, an enemy tank entered your row or column, or your move was blocked). Then you may send a new list, which replaces the rest of the old one.
Reply format, nothing else:
ACTIONS: <one or more of UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT FIRE STAY, separated by spaces>
WHY: <one sentence>
